name: Design Stakeholder Questionnaire
summary: Design a concise asynchronous questionnaire around decisions only a specific stakeholder can answer.
description: Design a stakeholder questionnaire that closes a defined knowledge gap with prioritized, single-purpose questions and usable answer fields. Use when the user must obtain facts or decisions from someone with unique context.
risk_reason: This skill designs a concise asynchronous questionnaire around decisions only a specific stakeholder can answer; it does not bury the highest-impact questions behind optional background and low-value detail.
refuses: It does not invent the stakeholder's answer or pressure the requester to answer on their behalf.
It does not collect credentials, unnecessary sensitive data, or information without a declared use.
It does not bury the highest-impact questions behind optional background and low-value detail.

operational.latency_reason: The skill designs a concise asynchronous questionnaire around decisions only a specific stakeholder can answer, using sequential evidence and verification steps.
